CacheReport.description: Cheap aggregate observations without cloning the cached inventory.

active_loads.description: Currently admitted replay/decode loads under the shared deployment gate.

bypasses.description: Explicit admission refusals, distinct from native eviction.

entries.description: Retained entry count (expired entries may await native TTL removal).

evictions.description: Upstream eviction totals are not exposed by `DefaultCache`.

inflight_bytes.description: Reserved transient replay/decode staging; native allocator peaks are separate.

live_bytes.description: All live value owners, including values evicted while readers retain them.

pinned_bytes.description: Reader-owned bytes are unavailable for native file cache value types.

policy_limit_bytes.description: Configured admission ceiling, distinct from a pool capacity reservation.

retained_bytes.description: Native retained entry extent; excludes upstream reader Arc clones.

ResourceConsumer.description: A current native memory consumer and its accounted reservation.

description: Pool counters do not claim global allocator coverage.

caches.description: Native retained capacities and hits, without cloning cached values.

pool_peak_bytes.description: Maximum accounted claims since this shared runtime was created.

pool_reserved_now.description: Current accounted claims across every query and platform consumer.

process_peak_rss_bytes.description: Whole-process peak resident bytes; None on unsupported platforms.

top_consumers.description: Largest current consumers, decreasing by bytes then increasing by owner name.

title: ResourceReport
